notes.title: Seduction visual & difficulty update
notes.content:
Seduction has 2 new updates - Visual update and Difficulty update

[b]1. Visual update[/b]

A visual change to make the game more appealing without losing the nostalgia feeling.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38477796/bdd57802ab74e4770d49e8e9d477e5a6e37d5ea7.jpg[/img]

[b]2. Difficulty setting[/b]

I am getting alot of mixed reactions to the difficulty of the puzzles so for players who wanted a little more challenge, they can choose the hard mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38477796/c2310002992ac4e9f72a6efc987f83d3c70d3ef4.jpg[/img]
